6.description: [Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kil'jaeden] Increased the damage of World Breaker first instance to 200% weapon damage up from 100%. World Breakers second instance now draws its cone shape along the ground as the first instance does.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kil'jaeden] Legion Lightning now increases in damage by a percentage value scaling with the number of player inside the raid, dealing more damage per jump as lower the total amount of player is. Previously each jump would double in damage. Legion lightning no longer chains to pets. Previously Legion Lightning would chain to and from pets without damaging them but eventually using them as gap closer to other player targets.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau + Black Temple] Corrected an issue where The Illidari Council, Felmyst, The Eredar Twins and Kil'jaeden could become stuck at 1 health.

This will allow soaking 3 slashes with a group of 4 player before a 4th slash becomes lethal. Meteor Slash will now reroll its individual damage, after damage has been split,  before applying it, making the damage inflicted less static.

6.description: [Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [Kil'jaeden] The Power of the Blue Dragon Flight now transforms the player using a dragon orb into the dragon itself rather then summoning a dragon to control. The dragons spells no longer have a mana cost and the transformation now lasts for 1 minute. The dragon is now considered a player target, however Kil'jaeden selects the dragon at a low priority when selecting targets. Kil'jaeden will still send his extra boss frames when a dragon orb is used, displaying the transformed players frame.
[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [M'uru] Cloak of Shadows will now correctly prevent the Black Holes Singularity effect.

[Pending Restart] [Sunwell Plateau] [M'uru] Darkness is now always active and had its radius reduced by 50%. Together with the changes to his hitbox, melee player can now attack M'uru from a comfortable distance without stepping into Darkness.
